sentences.text:
Author: Deepak Verma
Bench: Deepak Verma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 87
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 2668 of 2023
Applicant :- Rama Shanker Singh

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Santosh Kumar Shukla,Ambika Dutt Pandey,Ayush Mishra,

Paritosh S Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant Rama Shankar Singh with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No.221 of 2022, under Sections 420, 411, 467, 468 I.P.C.
& Section 66-D I.T.Act, P.S. Shivkuti, District Prayagraj during pendency of the trial.

Allegation in the FIR is that when informant went to withdraw amount from ATM machine, then four unknown persons came there and identified the ATM pin number of the informant and have also exchanged their ATM card and withdrew Rs.30,000/-.
It is argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
On 05.11.2022, police party arrested applicant with four other persons and from the possession of the applicant 13 credit and debit cards have been recovered.
Recovery is false and planted.
Applicant was arrested from his house.
Applicant has been implicated in the present case and five other cases.

entities.text: Rama Shanker Singh vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: There is no independent witness to support the prosecution case.
ATM cards which are alleged in the FIR, have not been recovered from the possession of the applicant.
There is no prospect of trial of the present case being concluded in near future due to heavy dockets.
The applicant is not a previous convict.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 06.11.2022 and in case he is enlarged on bail he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer of the applicant.

Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the nature of offence, evidence, complicity of accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and law laid down by the Apex Court in Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, passed in S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.

entities.text: Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant, Rama Shankar Singh, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
1. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
2. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
3. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

Order Date :- 22.3.2023 SKD  Rama Shanker Singh vs State Of U.P. on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155365330/
